question: In triangle PQR, PS is the bisector of ∠ QPR and PT ⊥ QR with ∠ Q > ∠ R. What is ∠ TPS?
solution:
**Given:**

Triangle PQR

PS = angle bisector of ∠QPR

PT ⟂ QR

∠Q > ∠R

**Formula used:**

Angle bisector divides ∠P into equal parts

Angle between altitude and bisector = (1/2)(∠Q − ∠R)

 
 P Q R 
• PS 
• PT 
• QR 

**Calculations:**

⇒ ∠QPR = A ⇒ PS divides into A/2 each

⇒ PT ⟂ QR ⇒ forms right angle

⇒ Using triangle geometry relation

⇒ ∠TPS = (1/2)(∠Q − ∠R)

**∴ The correct answer is (1/2)(∠Q − ∠R).**
